title: 경찰, '한강버스 허위사실 의혹' 오세훈 소환 조사…피고발인 신분
caption:
Seoul police have questioned Mayor Oh Se-hoon following a complaint over statements concerning the city's Han River bus project. City hall officials rejected the claims as politically motivated, with a statutory deadline approaching early next month.
